verses.text: For if I proclaim the good news, I have no boast, because necessity lies upon me. For woe to me if I do not proclaim the good news!
verses.display_text: For if I proclaim the good news, I have no boast, because necessity lies upon me. For woe to me if I do not proclaim the good news!

verses.text: For if I do this willingly, I have wages; but if unwillingly, I have been entrusted with a stewardship.
verses.display_text: For if I do this willingly, I have wages; but if unwillingly, I have been entrusted with a stewardship.

verses.text: What, then, are my wages? That when proclaiming the good news I may offer it without charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the good news.
verses.display_text: What, then, are my wages? That when proclaiming the good news I may offer it without charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the good news.

verses.text: For though free from all, I enslaved myself to all, so that I might win more of them.
verses.display_text: For though free from all, I enslaved myself to all, so that I might win more of them.

verses.text: To the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might win Jews; to those under law, as under law—though I myself am not under law—so that I might win those under law;
verses.display_text: To the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might win Jews; to those under law, as under law—though I myself am not under law—so that I might win those under law;

verses.text: to those without law, as without law—though not without God’s law but within Christ’s law—so that I might win those without law.
verses.display_text: to those without law, as without law—though not without God’s law but within Christ’s law—so that I might win those without law.

verses.text: To the weak I became weak, so that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all people, so that by all means I might save some.
verses.display_text: To the weak I became weak, so that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all people, so that by all means I might save some.

verses.text: I do all things for the sake of the good news, so that I may share in it with others.
verses.display_text: I do all things for the sake of the good news, so that I may share in it with others.

verses.text: Do you not know that all the runners in a stadium run, but one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may obtain it.
verses.display_text: Do you not know that all the runners in a stadium run, but one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may obtain it.

verses.text: Everyone who competes exercises self-control in all things. They do so to receive a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable one.
verses.display_text: Everyone who competes exercises self-control in all things. They do so to receive a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable one.

verses.text: So I run in this way, not aimlessly; I box in this way, not as one beating the air.
verses.display_text: So I run in this way, not aimlessly; I box in this way, not as one beating the air.

verses.text: Instead, I pummel my body and bring it into slavery, so that, after proclaiming to others, I myself may not become disqualified.
verses.display_text: Instead, I pummel my body and bring it into slavery, so that, after proclaiming to others, I myself may not become disqualified.

verses.text: For I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud and all passed through the sea,
verses.display_text: For I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud and all passed through the sea,

verses.text: and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea,
verses.display_text: and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea,

verses.text: and all ate the same spiritual food,
verses.display_text: and all ate the same spiritual food,

verses.text: and all drank the same spiritual drink, for they drank from a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
verses.display_text: and all drank the same spiritual drink, for they drank from a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

verses.text: But God was not pleased with most of them, for they were strewn over the wilderness.
verses.display_text: But God was not pleased with most of them, for they were strewn over the wilderness.

verses.text: Now these things became examples for us, so that we might not desire evil things as they also desired.
verses.display_text: Now these things became examples for us, so that we might not desire evil things as they also desired.

verses.text: Do not become idolaters, as some of them did, just as it is written: “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose to play.”
verses.display_text: Do not become idolaters, as some of them did, just as it is written: “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose to play.”

verses.text: Nor let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.
verses.display_text: Nor let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.

verses.text: Nor let us put Christ to the test, as some of them tested Him and were being destroyed by the serpents.
verses.display_text: Nor let us put Christ to the test, as some of them tested Him and were being destroyed by the serpents.

verses.text: Nor grumble, just as some of them grumbled and were destroyed by the destroyer.
verses.display_text: Nor grumble, just as some of them grumbled and were destroyed by the destroyer.

verses.text: These things happened to them as examples, and were written to admonish us, upon whom the ends of the ages have arrived.
verses.display_text: These things happened to them as examples, and were written to admonish us, upon whom the ends of the ages have arrived.

verses.text: So let the one who thinks he stands take care that he does not fall.
verses.display_text: So let the one who thinks he stands take care that he does not fall.

verses.text: No temptation has seized you except what is common to humanity. But God is faithful: He will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you can bear, but with the temptation will also provide the way out, so that you may be able to endure it.
verses.display_text: No temptation has seized you except what is common to humanity. But God is faithful: He will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you can bear, but with the temptation will also provide the way out, so that you may be able to endure it.

verses.text: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.display_text: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

verses.text: I speak as to wise people; judge for yourselves what I say.
verses.display_text: I speak as to wise people; judge for yourselves what I say.

verses.text: The cup of blessing that we bless—is it not participation in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break—is it not participation in the body of Christ?
verses.display_text: The cup of blessing that we bless—is it not participation in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break—is it not participation in the body of Christ?

verses.text: Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one bread.
verses.display_text: Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one bread.

verses.text: Consider Israel according to the flesh: are not those who eat the sacrifices participants in the altar?
verses.display_text: Consider Israel according to the flesh: are not those who eat the sacrifices participants in the altar?

verses.text: What, then, am I saying? That food offered to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?
verses.display_text: What, then, am I saying? That food offered to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

verses.text: Rather, that what they sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God. And I do not want you to become participants with demons.
verses.display_text: Rather, that what they sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God. And I do not want you to become participants with demons.

verses.text: You cannot drink the Lord’s cup and the cup of demons. You cannot partake of the Lord’s table and the table of demons.
verses.display_text: You cannot drink the Lord’s cup and the cup of demons. You cannot partake of the Lord’s table and the table of demons.

verses.text: Or are we provoking the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
verses.display_text: Or are we provoking the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?

verses.text: All things are permitted, but not all things are beneficial. All things are permitted, but not all things build up.
verses.display_text: All things are permitted, but not all things are beneficial. All things are permitted, but not all things build up.

verses.text: Let no one seek his own good, but the other’s.
verses.display_text: Let no one seek his own good, but the other’s.

verses.text: Eat everything sold in the meat market without examining it for conscience’s sake,
verses.display_text: Eat everything sold in the meat market without examining it for conscience’s sake,

verses.text: for “The earth is the Lord’s, and all that fills it.”
verses.display_text: for “The earth is the Lord’s, and all that fills it.”

verses.text: If any of the unbelievers invites you and you want to go, eat everything set before you without examining it for conscience’s sake.
verses.display_text: If any of the unbelievers invites you and you want to go, eat everything set before you without examining it for conscience’s sake.

verses.text: But if someone says to you, “This has been offered in sacrifice,” do not eat it, for the sake of the one who informed you and for conscience’s sake.
verses.display_text: But if someone says to you, “This has been offered in sacrifice,” do not eat it, for the sake of the one who informed you and for conscience’s sake.

verses.text: I mean not your own conscience, but the other’s. For why is my freedom judged by another conscience?
verses.display_text: I mean not your own conscience, but the other’s. For why is my freedom judged by another conscience?

verses.text: If I partake with thanksgiving, why am I slandered for what I give thanks for?
verses.display_text: If I partake with thanksgiving, why am I slandered for what I give thanks for?

verses.text: Therefore, whether you eat or drink or do anything, do everything for God’s glory.
verses.display_text: Therefore, whether you eat or drink or do anything, do everything for God’s glory.

verses.text: Give no cause for stumbling to Jews or Greeks or the Church of God,
verses.display_text: Give no cause for stumbling to Jews or Greeks or the Church of God,

verses.text: just as I too please everyone in everything, seeking not my own benefit but that of the many, so that they may be saved.
verses.display_text: just as I too please everyone in everything, seeking not my own benefit but that of the many, so that they may be saved.

verses.text: Imitate me, just as I also imitate Christ.
verses.display_text: Imitate me, just as I also imitate Christ.

verses.text: Now I praise you because you remember me in all things and hold fast to the traditions just as I handed them over to you.
verses.display_text: Now I praise you because you remember me in all things and hold fast to the traditions just as I handed them over to you.

verses.text: But I want you to know that the head of every man is Christ, the head of a woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.
verses.display_text: But I want you to know that the head of every man is Christ, the head of a woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

verses.text: Every man who prays or prophesies with something covering his head dishonors his head.
verses.display_text: Every man who prays or prophesies with something covering his head dishonors his head.

verses.text: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is one and the same as being shaved.
verses.display_text: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is one and the same as being shaved.

verses.text: For if a woman does not cover herself, let her also cut off her hair. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or to be shaved, let her cover herself.
verses.display_text: For if a woman does not cover herself, let her also cut off her hair. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or to be shaved, let her cover herself.

verses.text: For a man ought not to cover his head, being God’s image and glory; but the woman is the man’s glory.
verses.display_text: For a man ought not to cover his head, being God’s image and glory; but the woman is the man’s glory.

verses.text: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
verses.display_text: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

verses.text: for indeed man was not created for the woman’s sake, but woman for the man’s sake.
verses.display_text: for indeed man was not created for the woman’s sake, but woman for the man’s sake.

verses.text: For this reason the woman ought to have authority on her head, because of the angels.
verses.display_text: For this reason the woman ought to have authority on her head, because of the angels.

verses.text: Nevertheless, in the Lord neither is woman without man nor man without woman.
verses.display_text: Nevertheless, in the Lord neither is woman without man nor man without woman.

verses.text: For just as woman is from man, so also man is through woman; but all things are from God.
verses.display_text: For just as woman is from man, so also man is through woman; but all things are from God.

verses.text: Judge among yourselves: is it fitting for a woman to pray to God uncovered?
verses.display_text: Judge among yourselves: is it fitting for a woman to pray to God uncovered?

verses.text: Does not nature itself teach you that if a man wears long hair it is a dishonor to him,
verses.display_text: Does not nature itself teach you that if a man wears long hair it is a dishonor to him,

verses.text: but if a woman wears long hair it is a glory to her? For the hair has been given to her as a covering.
verses.display_text: but if a woman wears long hair it is a glory to her? For the hair has been given to her as a covering.

verses.text: But if anyone is inclined to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor do the Churches of God.
verses.display_text: But if anyone is inclined to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor do the Churches of God.

verses.text: But in giving this instruction I do not praise you, because you come together for the worse rather than for the better.
verses.display_text: But in giving this instruction I do not praise you, because you come together for the worse rather than for the better.

verses.text: For first, when you come together as a Church, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I believe it in part.
verses.display_text: For first, when you come together as a Church, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I believe it in part.

verses.text: For there must even be factions among you so that those who are approved may also become evident among you.
verses.display_text: For there must even be factions among you so that those who are approved may also become evident among you.

verses.text: Therefore, when you gather in the same place, it is not to eat the Lord’s supper,
verses.display_text: Therefore, when you gather in the same place, it is not to eat the Lord’s supper,

verses.text: for in eating, each takes his own supper beforehand, and one is hungry while another is drunk.
verses.display_text: for in eating, each takes his own supper beforehand, and one is hungry while another is drunk.

verses.text: Do you not have houses for eating and drinking? Or do you despise God’s Church and shame those who have nothing? What should I say to you? Should I praise you? In this I do not praise you.
verses.display_text: Do you not have houses for eating and drinking? Or do you despise God’s Church and shame those who have nothing? What should I say to you? Should I praise you? In this I do not praise you.

verses.text: For I received from the Lord what I also handed over to you: that the Lord Jesus, on the night when He was being handed over, took bread,
verses.display_text: For I received from the Lord what I also handed over to you: that the Lord Jesus, on the night when He was being handed over, took bread,

verses.text: and after giving thanks He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you. Do this in remembrance of Me.”
verses.display_text: and after giving thanks He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you. Do this in remembrance of Me.”

verses.text: Likewise He also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in remembrance of Me.”
verses.display_text: Likewise He also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in remembrance of Me.”

verses.text: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
verses.display_text: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.

verses.text: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the Lord’s cup unworthily will be answerable for the Lord’s body and blood.
verses.display_text: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the Lord’s cup unworthily will be answerable for the Lord’s body and blood.

verses.text: Let a person examine himself, and in this way let him eat from the bread and drink from the cup.
verses.display_text: Let a person examine himself, and in this way let him eat from the bread and drink from the cup.

verses.text: For the one who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment upon himself.
verses.display_text: For the one who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment upon himself.

verses.text: For this reason many among you are weak and ill, and a considerable number are asleep.
verses.display_text: For this reason many among you are weak and ill, and a considerable number are asleep.

verses.text: But if we discerned ourselves, we would not be judged.
verses.display_text: But if we discerned ourselves, we would not be judged.

verses.text: Yet when we are judged by the Lord, we are disciplined, so that we may not be condemned with the world.
verses.display_text: Yet when we are judged by the Lord, we are disciplined, so that we may not be condemned with the world.

verses.text: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
verses.display_text: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

verses.text: If anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, so that you may not come together for judgment. I will arrange the remaining matters when I come.
verses.display_text: If anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, so that you may not come together for judgment. I will arrange the remaining matters when I come.

verses.text: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I do not want you to be unaware.
verses.display_text: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I do not want you to be unaware.

verses.text: You know that when you were Gentiles, you were carried away to the mute idols, however you were led.
verses.display_text: You know that when you were Gentiles, you were carried away to the mute idols, however you were led.

verses.text: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking in God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except in the Holy Spirit.
verses.display_text: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking in God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except in the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: There are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit;
verses.display_text: There are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit;

verses.text: and there are varieties of service, and the same Lord;
verses.display_text: and there are varieties of service, and the same Lord;

verses.text: and there are varieties of work, but the same God, who works all things in everyone.
verses.display_text: and there are varieties of work, but the same God, who works all things in everyone.

verses.text: To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common benefit.
verses.display_text: To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common benefit.

verses.text: For to one a word of wisdom is given through the Spirit, and to another a word of knowledge according to the same Spirit;
verses.display_text: For to one a word of wisdom is given through the Spirit, and to another a word of knowledge according to the same Spirit;

verses.text: to another faith in the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings in the one Spirit;
verses.display_text: to another faith in the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings in the one Spirit;

verses.text: to another acts of power, to another prophecy, to another discernments of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.
verses.display_text: to another acts of power, to another prophecy, to another discernments of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.

verses.text: But the one and the same Spirit works all these things, distributing to each individually just as He wills.
verses.display_text: But the one and the same Spirit works all these things, distributing to each individually just as He wills.

verses.text: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the body’s members, though many, are one body, so also is Christ.
verses.display_text: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the body’s members, though many, are one body, so also is Christ.

verses.text: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
verses.display_text: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.

verses.text: For the body is not one member but many.
verses.display_text: For the body is not one member but many.

verses.text: If the foot says, “Because I am not a hand, I am not part of the body,” that does not stop it from being part of the body, does it?
verses.display_text: If the foot says, “Because I am not a hand, I am not part of the body,” that does not stop it from being part of the body, does it?

verses.text: And if the ear says, “Because I am not an eye, I am not part of the body,” that does not stop it from being part of the body, does it?
verses.display_text: And if the ear says, “Because I am not an eye, I am not part of the body,” that does not stop it from being part of the body, does it?

verses.text: If the whole body were an eye, where would hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the sense of smell be?
verses.display_text: If the whole body were an eye, where would hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the sense of smell be?

verses.text: But as it is, God placed the members, each one of them, in the body just as He wished.
verses.display_text: But as it is, God placed the members, each one of them, in the body just as He wished.

verses.text: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
verses.display_text: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

verses.text: But as it is, there are many members, yet one body.
verses.display_text: But as it is, there are many members, yet one body.

verses.text: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I have no need of you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need of you.”
verses.display_text: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I have no need of you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need of you.”

verses.text: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem weaker are much more necessary,
verses.display_text: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem weaker are much more necessary,

verses.text: and those parts of the body we consider less honorable, we clothe with greater honor; and our unpresentable parts receive greater modesty,
verses.display_text: and those parts of the body we consider less honorable, we clothe with greater honor; and our unpresentable parts receive greater modesty,

verses.text: while our presentable parts have no need of it. But God combined the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,
verses.display_text: while our presentable parts have no need of it. But God combined the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,

verses.text: so that there may be no division in the body, but that the members may have the same care for one another.
verses.display_text: so that there may be no division in the body, but that the members may have the same care for one another.

verses.text: If one member suffers, all the members suffer together; if one member is honored, all the members rejoice together.
verses.display_text: If one member suffers, all the members suffer together; if one member is honored, all the members rejoice together.

verses.text: Now you are Christ’s body, and individually members of it.
verses.display_text: Now you are Christ’s body, and individually members of it.

verses.text: God has appointed in the Church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then acts of power, then gifts of healings, helps, forms of guidance, and kinds of tongues.
verses.display_text: God has appointed in the Church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then acts of power, then gifts of healings, helps, forms of guidance, and kinds of tongues.

verses.text: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all perform acts of power?
verses.display_text: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all perform acts of power?

verses.text: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
verses.display_text: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

verses.text: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And I show you a way beyond all comparison.
verses.display_text: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And I show you a way beyond all comparison.

verses.text: If I speak in the tongues of human beings and of angels but have no love, I have become resounding bronze or a clanging cymbal.
verses.display_text: If I speak in the tongues of human beings and of angels but have no love, I have become resounding bronze or a clanging cymbal.

verses.text: And if I have prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to move mountains, but have no love, I am nothing.
verses.display_text: And if I have prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to move mountains, but have no love, I am nothing.

verses.text: And if I distribute all my possessions as food, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but have no love, I gain nothing.
verses.display_text: And if I distribute all my possessions as food, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but have no love, I gain nothing.

verses.text: Love is patient; love is kind; it does not envy; [love] does not boast, is not puffed up,
verses.display_text: Love is patient; love is kind; it does not envy; [love] does not boast, is not puffed up,

verses.text: does not behave shamefully, does not seek its own interests, is not provoked, does not keep account of wrong,
verses.display_text: does not behave shamefully, does not seek its own interests, is not provoked, does not keep account of wrong,

verses.text: does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth.
verses.display_text: does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth.

verses.text: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
verses.display_text: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

verses.text: Love never falls. But prophecies will be brought to an end; tongues will cease; knowledge will be brought to an end.
verses.display_text: Love never falls. But prophecies will be brought to an end; tongues will cease; knowledge will be brought to an end.

verses.text: For we know in part and prophesy in part,
verses.display_text: For we know in part and prophesy in part,

verses.text: but when what is complete comes, what is partial will be brought to an end.
verses.display_text: but when what is complete comes, what is partial will be brought to an end.

verses.text: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, thought as a child, reasoned as a child. When I became a man, I brought the child’s ways to an end.
verses.display_text: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, thought as a child, reasoned as a child. When I became a man, I brought the child’s ways to an end.

verses.text: For now we see through a mirror, as in a riddle, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, just as I also was fully known.
verses.display_text: For now we see through a mirror, as in a riddle, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, just as I also was fully known.

verses.text: And now faith, hope, and love remain, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
verses.display_text: And now faith, hope, and love remain, these three; but the greatest of these is love.

verses.text: Pursue love, and earnestly desire spiritual things, especially that you may prophesy.
verses.display_text: Pursue love, and earnestly desire spiritual things, especially that you may prophesy.

verses.text: For the one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to human beings but to God, for no one understands him; in spirit he speaks mysteries.
verses.display_text: For the one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to human beings but to God, for no one understands him; in spirit he speaks mysteries.

verses.text: But the one who prophesies speaks to human beings for building up, encouragement, and consolation.
verses.display_text: But the one who prophesies speaks to human beings for building up, encouragement, and consolation.

verses.text: The one who speaks in a tongue builds himself up, but the one who prophesies builds up the Church.
verses.display_text: The one who speaks in a tongue builds himself up, but the one who prophesies builds up the Church.

verses.text: I want all of you to speak in tongues, but still more that you should prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the Church may be built up.
verses.display_text: I want all of you to speak in tongues, but still more that you should prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the Church may be built up.

verses.text: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you in revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
verses.display_text: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you in revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?

verses.text: Even lifeless things that give a sound, whether a flute or a lyre—if they do not produce distinct notes, how will what is played on the flute or lyre be recognized?
verses.display_text: Even lifeless things that give a sound, whether a flute or a lyre—if they do not produce distinct notes, how will what is played on the flute or lyre be recognized?

verses.text: For if a trumpet gives an unclear sound, who will prepare for battle?
verses.display_text: For if a trumpet gives an unclear sound, who will prepare for battle?

verses.text: So also with you: unless you speak an intelligible word with your tongue, how will what is spoken be known? For you will be speaking into the air.
verses.display_text: So also with you: unless you speak an intelligible word with your tongue, how will what is spoken be known? For you will be speaking into the air.

verses.text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none is voiceless.
verses.display_text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none is voiceless.

verses.text: Therefore, if I do not know the meaning of the voice, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker a foreigner to me.
verses.display_text: Therefore, if I do not know the meaning of the voice, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker a foreigner to me.

verses.text: So also with you: since you are zealous for spirits, seek to excel for the building up of the Church.
verses.display_text: So also with you: since you are zealous for spirits, seek to excel for the building up of the Church.

verses.text: Therefore let the one who speaks in a tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.display_text: Therefore let the one who speaks in a tongue pray that he may interpret.

verses.text: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
verses.display_text: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

verses.text: What, then, is to be done? I will pray with the spirit, but I will also pray with the mind. I will sing with the spirit, but I will also sing with the mind.
verses.display_text: What, then, is to be done? I will pray with the spirit, but I will also pray with the mind. I will sing with the spirit, but I will also sing with the mind.

verses.text: Otherwise, if you bless in spirit, how will the person in the place of the uninitiated say the Amen to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
verses.display_text: Otherwise, if you bless in spirit, how will the person in the place of the uninitiated say the Amen to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?

verses.text: For you give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
verses.display_text: For you give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

verses.text: I thank God; I speak in tongues more than all of you.
verses.display_text: I thank God; I speak in tongues more than all of you.

verses.text: But in Church I would rather speak five words with my mind, so that I may instruct others too, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
verses.display_text: But in Church I would rather speak five words with my mind, so that I may instruct others too, than ten thousand words in a tongue.

verses.text: Brothers, do not become children in your thinking. Be infants in evil, but become mature in your thinking.
verses.display_text: Brothers, do not become children in your thinking. Be infants in evil, but become mature in your thinking.

verses.text: In the law it is written, “Through people of other tongues and through the lips of others I will speak to this people, and even so they will not listen to Me,” says the Lord.
verses.display_text: In the law it is written, “Through people of other tongues and through the lips of others I will speak to this people, and even so they will not listen to Me,” says the Lord.

verses.text: So tongues are a sign for unbelievers, not for believers, while prophecy is for believers, not for unbelievers.
verses.display_text: So tongues are a sign for unbelievers, not for believers, while prophecy is for believers, not for unbelievers.

verses.text: Therefore, if the whole Church gathers in the same place and everyone speaks in tongues, and uninitiated people or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are mad?
verses.display_text: Therefore, if the whole Church gathers in the same place and everyone speaks in tongues, and uninitiated people or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are mad?

verses.text: But if everyone prophesies and an unbeliever or an uninitiated person enters, he is exposed by all, examined by all;
verses.display_text: But if everyone prophesies and an unbeliever or an uninitiated person enters, he is exposed by all, examined by all;

verses.text: the hidden things of his heart are revealed, and so, falling on his face, he will worship God, declaring, “God is truly among you.”
verses.display_text: the hidden things of his heart are revealed, and so, falling on his face, he will worship God, declaring, “God is truly among you.”

verses.text: What, then, is to be done, brothers? When you gather, each has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let everything be done for building up.
verses.display_text: What, then, is to be done, brothers? When you gather, each has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let everything be done for building up.

verses.text: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let it be by two or at most three, each in turn, and let one interpret.
verses.display_text: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let it be by two or at most three, each in turn, and let one interpret.

verses.text: But if there is no interpreter, let him be silent in Church, and let him speak to himself and to God.
verses.display_text: But if there is no interpreter, let him be silent in Church, and let him speak to himself and to God.

verses.text: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others discern.
verses.display_text: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others discern.

verses.text: But if something is revealed to another who is seated, let the first be silent.
verses.display_text: But if something is revealed to another who is seated, let the first be silent.

verses.text: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be encouraged.
verses.display_text: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be encouraged.

verses.text: And prophets’ spirits are subject to prophets,
verses.display_text: And prophets’ spirits are subject to prophets,

verses.text: for God is not a God of disorder but of peace. As in all the Churches of the saints,
verses.display_text: for God is not a God of disorder but of peace. As in all the Churches of the saints,

verses.text: let the women be silent in the Churches, for they are not permitted to speak; instead, let them be subject, just as the law also says.
verses.display_text: let the women be silent in the Churches, for they are not permitted to speak; instead, let them be subject, just as the law also says.

verses.text: If they want to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to speak in Church.
verses.display_text: If they want to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to speak in Church.

verses.text: Or did God’s word go out from you? Or has it reached you alone?
verses.display_text: Or did God’s word go out from you? Or has it reached you alone?

verses.text: If anyone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize that what I write to you is the Lord’s command.
verses.display_text: If anyone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize that what I write to you is the Lord’s command.

verses.text: But if anyone does not recognize this, he is not recognized.
verses.display_text: But if anyone does not recognize this, he is not recognized.

verses.text: Therefore, my brothers, earnestly desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
verses.display_text: Therefore, my brothers, earnestly desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

verses.text: But let everything be done fittingly and in order.
verses.display_text: But let everything be done fittingly and in order.

verses.text: Now I make known to you, brothers, the good news that I proclaimed to you, which you also received, in which you also stand,
verses.display_text: Now I make known to you, brothers, the good news that I proclaimed to you, which you also received, in which you also stand,

verses.text: through which you are also being saved, if you hold fast to the word in which I proclaimed it to you—unless you believed in vain.
verses.display_text: through which you are also being saved, if you hold fast to the word in which I proclaimed it to you—unless you believed in vain.

verses.text: For I handed over to you as matters of first importance what I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
verses.display_text: For I handed over to you as matters of first importance what I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

verses.text: and that He was buried, and that He has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
verses.display_text: and that He was buried, and that He has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

verses.text: and that He appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
verses.display_text: and that He appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

verses.text: After that He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, though some have fallen asleep.
verses.display_text: After that He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, though some have fallen asleep.

verses.text: After that He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
verses.display_text: After that He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

verses.text: Last of all, as to one untimely born, He appeared also to me.
verses.display_text: Last of all, as to one untimely born, He appeared also to me.

verses.text: For I am the least of the apostles, unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted God’s Church.
verses.display_text: For I am the least of the apostles, unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted God’s Church.

verses.text: But by God’s grace I am what I am, and His grace toward me was not empty. Instead, I labored more than all of them—yet not I, but God’s grace with me.
verses.display_text: But by God’s grace I am what I am, and His grace toward me was not empty. Instead, I labored more than all of them—yet not I, but God’s grace with me.

verses.text: So whether it was I or they, this is how we proclaim, and this is how you believed.
verses.display_text: So whether it was I or they, this is how we proclaim, and this is how you believed.

verses.text: Now if Christ is proclaimed as raised from the dead, how can some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.display_text: Now if Christ is proclaimed as raised from the dead, how can some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

verses.text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
verses.display_text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

verses.text: And if Christ has not been raised, then our proclamation is also empty, and your faith is empty too.
verses.display_text: And if Christ has not been raised, then our proclamation is also empty, and your faith is empty too.

verses.text: We are also found to be false witnesses concerning God, because we testified against God that He raised Christ, whom He did not raise if, after all, the dead are not raised.
verses.display_text: We are also found to be false witnesses concerning God, because we testified against God that He raised Christ, whom He did not raise if, after all, the dead are not raised.

verses.text: For if the dead are not raised, neither has Christ been raised.
verses.display_text: For if the dead are not raised, neither has Christ been raised.

verses.text: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
verses.display_text: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

verses.text: Then those who have fallen asleep in Christ have also perished.
verses.display_text: Then those who have fallen asleep in Christ have also perished.

verses.text: If in this life alone we have hoped in Christ, we are more to be pitied than all other people.
verses.display_text: If in this life alone we have hoped in Christ, we are more to be pitied than all other people.

verses.text: But as it is, Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
verses.display_text: But as it is, Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

verses.text: For since death came through a human being, resurrection of the dead also comes through a human being.
verses.display_text: For since death came through a human being, resurrection of the dead also comes through a human being.

verses.text: For just as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
verses.display_text: For just as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

verses.text: But each in his own order: Christ the firstfruits, then those who belong to Christ at His coming,
verses.display_text: But each in his own order: Christ the firstfruits, then those who belong to Christ at His coming,

verses.text: then the end, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father, when He brings to nothing every rule and every authority and power.
verses.display_text: then the end, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father, when He brings to nothing every rule and every authority and power.

verses.text: For He must reign until He puts all the enemies under His feet.
verses.display_text: For He must reign until He puts all the enemies under His feet.

verses.text: The last enemy to be brought to nothing is death,
verses.display_text: The last enemy to be brought to nothing is death,

verses.text: for “He subjected all things under His feet.” But when it says that all things have been subjected, it is clear that this excludes the One who subjected all things to Him.
verses.display_text: for “He subjected all things under His feet.” But when it says that all things have been subjected, it is clear that this excludes the One who subjected all things to Him.

verses.text: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will also be subjected to the One who subjected all things to Him, so that God may be all in all.
verses.display_text: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will also be subjected to the One who subjected all things to Him, so that God may be all in all.

verses.text: Otherwise, what will those who are baptized for the dead do? If the dead are not raised at all, why are they even baptized for them?
verses.display_text: Otherwise, what will those who are baptized for the dead do? If the dead are not raised at all, why are they even baptized for them?

verses.text: Why are we also in danger every hour?
verses.display_text: Why are we also in danger every hour?

verses.text: I die daily, brothers—I affirm it by my boasting in you, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.display_text: I die daily, brothers—I affirm it by my boasting in you, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.text: If in a merely human way I fought with beasts in Ephesus, what benefit is there for me? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
verses.display_text: If in a merely human way I fought with beasts in Ephesus, what benefit is there for me? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

verses.text: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good habits.”
verses.display_text: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good habits.”

verses.text: Sober up as you ought and do not sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I speak to your shame.
verses.display_text: Sober up as you ought and do not sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I speak to your shame.

verses.text: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised? With what sort of body do they come?”
verses.display_text: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised? With what sort of body do they come?”

verses.text: Foolish one! What you sow is not made alive unless it dies.
verses.display_text: Foolish one! What you sow is not made alive unless it dies.

verses.text: And what you sow is not the body that will come to be, but a bare grain, perhaps of wheat or of one of the other kinds.
verses.display_text: And what you sow is not the body that will come to be, but a bare grain, perhaps of wheat or of one of the other kinds.

verses.text: But God gives it a body just as He wished, and to each of the seeds its own body.
verses.display_text: But God gives it a body just as He wished, and to each of the seeds its own body.

verses.text: Not all flesh is the same flesh: human flesh is one kind, the flesh of animals another, the flesh of birds another, and that of fish another.
verses.display_text: Not all flesh is the same flesh: human flesh is one kind, the flesh of animals another, the flesh of birds another, and that of fish another.

verses.text: There are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, but the glory of the heavenly is one kind and that of the earthly another.
verses.display_text: There are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, but the glory of the heavenly is one kind and that of the earthly another.

verses.text: The sun has one glory, the moon another glory, and the stars another glory; for star differs from star in glory.
verses.display_text: The sun has one glory, the moon another glory, and the stars another glory; for star differs from star in glory.

verses.text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption.
verses.display_text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption.

verses.text: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
verses.display_text: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

verses.text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual one.
verses.display_text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual one.

verses.text: So also it is written, “The first human being, Adam, became a living soul”; the last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
verses.display_text: So also it is written, “The first human being, Adam, became a living soul”; the last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

verses.text: But the spiritual is not first; the natural is first, then the spiritual.
verses.display_text: But the spiritual is not first; the natural is first, then the spiritual.

verses.text: The first human being is from the earth, made of dust; the second human being is from heaven.
verses.display_text: The first human being is from the earth, made of dust; the second human being is from heaven.

verses.text: As is the one made of dust, so also are those made of dust; and as is the heavenly One, so also are the heavenly ones.
verses.display_text: As is the one made of dust, so also are those made of dust; and as is the heavenly One, so also are the heavenly ones.

verses.text: And just as we bore the image of the one made of dust, we will also bear the image of the heavenly One.
verses.display_text: And just as we bore the image of the one made of dust, we will also bear the image of the heavenly One.

verses.text: Now I say this, brothers: flesh and blood cannot inherit God’s kingdom, nor does corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.display_text: Now I say this, brothers: flesh and blood cannot inherit God’s kingdom, nor does corruption inherit incorruption.

verses.text: Look, I tell you a mystery: we will not all fall asleep, but we will all be changed,
verses.display_text: Look, I tell you a mystery: we will not all fall asleep, but we will all be changed,

verses.text: in an instant, in the blink of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
verses.display_text: in an instant, in the blink of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

verses.text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.display_text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

verses.text: But when this corruptible puts on incorruption and this mortal puts on immortality, then the written saying will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
verses.display_text: But when this corruptible puts on incorruption and this mortal puts on immortality, then the written saying will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”

verses.text: “Where, death, is your victory? Where, death, is your sting?”
verses.display_text: “Where, death, is your victory? Where, death, is your sting?”

verses.text: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
verses.display_text: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

verses.text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.display_text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, knowing that your labor is not empty in the Lord.
verses.display_text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, knowing that your labor is not empty in the Lord.

verses.text: Now concerning the collection for the saints: just as I directed the Churches of Galatia, so you also are to do.
verses.display_text: Now concerning the collection for the saints: just as I directed the Churches of Galatia, so you also are to do.

verses.text: On the first day of every week, let each of you set something aside on his own, saving as he prospers, so that collections may not be made when I come.
verses.display_text: On the first day of every week, let each of you set something aside on his own, saving as he prospers, so that collections may not be made when I come.

verses.text: When I arrive, I will send, with letters, those whom you approve to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: When I arrive, I will send, with letters, those whom you approve to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

verses.text: If it is fitting for me to go as well, they will go with me.
verses.display_text: If it is fitting for me to go as well, they will go with me.

verses.text: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am going through Macedonia.
verses.display_text: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am going through Macedonia.

verses.text: Perhaps I will remain with you, or even spend the winter, so that you may send me onward wherever I go.
verses.display_text: Perhaps I will remain with you, or even spend the winter, so that you may send me onward wherever I go.

verses.text: For I do not want to see you now merely in passing; I hope to remain with you for some time, if the Lord permits.
verses.display_text: For I do not want to see you now merely in passing; I hope to remain with you for some time, if the Lord permits.

verses.text: But I will remain in Ephesus until Pentecost,
verses.display_text: But I will remain in Ephesus until Pentecost,

verses.text: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many opponents.
verses.display_text: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many opponents.

verses.text: If Timothy comes, see that he may be with you without fear, for he works the Lord’s work just as I do.
verses.display_text: If Timothy comes, see that he may be with you without fear, for he works the Lord’s work just as I do.

verses.text: Therefore let no one despise him. Send him onward in peace, so that he may come to me, for I await him with the brothers.
verses.display_text: Therefore let no one despise him. Send him onward in peace, so that he may come to me, for I await him with the brothers.

verses.text: Now concerning Apollos the brother: I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was certainly not his wish to come now. He will come when he has opportunity.
verses.display_text: Now concerning Apollos the brother: I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was certainly not his wish to come now. He will come when he has opportunity.

verses.text: Stay awake; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.
verses.display_text: Stay awake; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

verses.text: Let everything among you be done in love.
verses.display_text: Let everything among you be done in love.

verses.text: Now I appeal to you, brothers—you know the household of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia and that they devoted themselves to serving the saints—
verses.display_text: Now I appeal to you, brothers—you know the household of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia and that they devoted themselves to serving the saints—

verses.text: that you too submit to such people, and to everyone who works together and labors.
verses.display_text: that you too submit to such people, and to everyone who works together and labors.

verses.text: I rejoice at the arrival of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because they filled what was lacking on your part,
verses.display_text: I rejoice at the arrival of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because they filled what was lacking on your part,

verses.text: for they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore recognize such people.
verses.display_text: for they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore recognize such people.

verses.text: The Churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Prisca, together with the Church in their house, greet you warmly in the Lord.
verses.display_text: The Churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Prisca, together with the Church in their house, greet you warmly in the Lord.

verses.text: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.display_text: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

verses.text: The greeting is in my own hand—Paul’s.
verses.display_text: The greeting is in my own hand—Paul’s.

verses.text: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!
verses.display_text: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!

verses.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.display_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

verses.text: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus.
verses.display_text: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus.
